title.description: The title a group room was created with.

deleted.description: Always `true`: the marker of a deleted message.

avatar.description: The person's avatar: a URL or a glyph, if they have set one.

name.description: The person's display name, if they have set one.

reactorProfile.description: The profile the reactor reacted under.

sentAt.description: The room's handler clock when it recorded the reaction.

authorProfile.description: The profile the sender sent under; absent once obliterated.

body.description: The current text, or the marker of a deleted message.

editedAt.description: The handler clock at the latest edit or deletion; absent until then.

reactions.description: The message's reactions; absent once the message is deleted.

replyTo.description: What this message replies to, and where it is shown.

sentAt.description: The handler clock when the room recorded the message.

authorProfile.description: The profile the sender sent under; absent once obliterated.

body.description: The current text, or the marker of a deleted message.

replyTo.description: Where the message's own reply is shown; absent for none.

sentAt.description: The room's handler clock when it recorded the message.

message.description:
The message replied to, in the same room, read as `RepliedMessage`. The
link carries no more of the message's schema than that, so a message's
schema nests no message: a reply typed as the message it replies to would
nest without end, the generator would cut the nesting at a depth that
varies with the type a writer addresses the message by, and a write cut
shallower than the stored schema would drop the policies stored below
the cut and be refused.

argumentSchema.description:
What a room stores. Each record but `about` has a default, so a space's own
chat starts with none of them.

about.description:
What the room says about itself, written once by the manager that creates
it. A space's own chat has none, and reads as a group room with no title.

participants.description:
Those who joined the room. It changes only through `addParticipant`, the
one writer its write contract admits.

titles.description:
The room's title as a member last set it. It changes only through
`setTitle`.

title.description: The title a group room was created with.

profile.description:
The new member's profile, whose `represents-principal` label names them,
through whose share inbox the viewer's manager offers them the room.

requestId.description:
Chosen by the sender, and unique among its adds. The outcome is recorded
under it, and sending the same event again with it changes nothing. A
rendered control's click carries none, and is given one of its own.

target.description: The control, holding the new member's chat address.

delivery.description:
How they were told of the room; absent until the adder's manager has
decided.

deliveryRefusal.description:
Why the adder's manager refused to tell them of the room, where it did,
which makes `delivery` `access-only`.

status.description: The person was admitted, or held the access already.

code.description:
Which refusal it is, for a client to act on, where a client has one to
take; absent for the others.

reason.description: Why, for a person to read.

status.description: The add was refused, and nothing was granted.

deleted.description: Always `true`: the marker of a deleted message.

count.description: How many messages the room holds, obliterated tombstones included.

latest.description: The newest messages of the main conversation, kept current.

hasOlder.description: Whether the main conversation has older messages than these.

messages.description: Up to `maxWindowCount` of them, oldest first.

newestAt.description: The newest message's `sentAt`; absent while there are none.

oldestAt.description: The oldest message's `sentAt`; absent while there are none.

threads.description:
Every thread in the room that holds a reply, oldest root first. A message
of the main conversation that roots none has no entry.

canEdit.description: Whether they may record a new version of it.

avatar.description: The person's avatar: a URL or a glyph, if they have set one.

name.description: The person's display name, if they have set one.

reactorProfile.description: The profile the reactor reacted under.

sentAt.description: The room's handler clock when it recorded the reaction.

createdAt.description: When the room was created; absent for a space's own chat.

kind.description: `"direct"` if created as a direct room; `"group"` otherwise.

policy.description: The room's policy, stated correctly, in a document of its own.

record.description:
The record the room's creator wrote, whose label names them; absent for a
space's own chat, which no one created as a room.

title.description:
The room's title, which every member shares: the one a member last set,
or else the one the room was created with. A direct room has none until a
member sets one, and a space's own chat has none.

deletionIsObliteration.description: Whether a sender's deletion of their own message obliterates it.

keepsHistory.description: Stated for the policy's shape, and read by nothing: a message keeps no history.

maxOpenWindows.description: Stated for the policy's shape, and read by nothing: the room offers no windows.

maxWindowCount.description: How many of the newest messages `messages.latest` holds.

ownersMayObliterate.description: Whether an OWNER may obliterate messages.

proposedTimeMaxAgeNsec.description: Stated for the policy's shape, and read by nothing: a sender proposes no time.

proposedTimeMaxLeadNsec.description: Stated for the policy's shape, and read by nothing: a sender proposes no time.

recentActivityWindowNsec.description: Stated for the policy's shape, and read by nothing: the room keeps no activity log.

about.description: What the room says about itself.

addMember.description:
Admits someone to the room's space, with OWNER, from a trusted gesture on
the rendering's `ChatAddMemberSurface`, or from a client's own control
through the sanctioned issuing path, and has the viewer's manager tell
them of the room. Only an OWNER of a group room in a space of its own may
admit someone.

addParticipant.description:
Adds a profile to those who joined the room, once. Any participant may add
any profile, so an entry is a claim: it does not say that the profile's
principal holds access to the room's space.

addRequests.description:
The outcome of each of this reader's adds, by its `requestId`, with how
the member was told of the room once that is decided.

canAdd.description:
Whether this reader can add someone: an OWNER of a group room in a space
of its own.

canSend.description: Whether this reader can send, edit, delete, and react.

deleteMessage.description: Records one of the sender's messages as deleted.

deleteReaction.description: Removes the sender's reaction to a message.

editMessage.description: Records a new version of one of the sender's messages.

messageRights.description:
What this reader may do to each of the room's messages, oldest first.
Nothing at all while `canSend` doesn't hold.

obliterateMessage.description: Reduces a message to a tombstone.

participantEntries.description:
One entry for each of `participants`, in their order: the profile, and the
principal its `represents-principal` label attests, absent where it
attests none or the label can't be read where the list is derived. Like
`participants`, it is not proof of access.

participantPrincipals.description:
The principals `participantEntries` holds, each once, in the order of
`participants`.

participants.description:
The room's participants: for a room that is its space's root, those who
joined it; for any other, its space's participants as the space's root
lists them, then those who joined the room itself; and then any author
neither lists.

roster.description:
Those who joined the room itself, each added once through
`addParticipant`, in the order they were added. Unlike `participants`, it
lists no author it doesn't hold, and no participant of another space, so
it is read from the roster alone. Like `participants`, it is a claim, not
proof of access.

sendReaction.description: Adds the sender's reaction to a message.

setTitle.description:
Sets the room's title, which every member shares, from a trusted gesture
on the rendering's `ChatRetitleSurface`, or from a client's own control
through the sanctioned issuing path. Any member who can write in the room
may, in a group room or a direct one.

titleRequests.description: The outcome of each of this reader's retitles, by its `requestId`.

viewer.description: Who is reading the room: their profile, its principal, and their access.

principal.description:
The principal the reader's profile's `represents-principal` label attests;
absent when it attests none, or the label can't be read.

profile.description:
The reader's profile, as a link to the profile itself, which is the form
a message's `authorProfile` takes; absent until it resolves.

role.description:
The reader's access to the room's space, as its access list grants it;
absent while that isn't known.

replyCount.description: How many messages the thread holds besides its root; never 0.

root.description: The thread's root, a message the main conversation shows.

profile.description: The profile, as the live cell in its own space.

authorProfile.description: The profile the sender sent under; absent once obliterated.

body.description: The current text, or the marker of a deleted message.

editedAt.description: The handler clock at the latest edit or deletion; absent until then.

reactions.description: The message's reactions; absent once the message is deleted.

replyTo.description: What this message replies to, and where it is shown.

sentAt.description: The handler clock when the room recorded the message.

principal.description:
The principal the profile's `represents-principal` label attests; absent
when it attests none, or when the label can't be read where the entry is
derived.

authorProfile.description: The profile the sender sent under; absent once obliterated.

body.description: The current text, or the marker of a deleted message.

replyTo.description: Where the message's own reply is shown; absent for none.

sentAt.description: The room's handler clock when it recorded the message.

body.description: The text to send, or to record as a message's new version.

reaction.description: The reaction removed, one of the message's.

replyTo.description: What a sent message replies to.

requestId.description:
Chosen by the sender, and unique among its retitles. The outcome is
recorded under it, and sending the same event again with it changes
nothing.

status.description: The request set the room's title.

code.description: Which refusal it is, for a client to act on.

reason.description: Why, for a person to read.

status.description: The retitle was refused, and the title is as it was.

message.description:
The message replied to, in the same room, read as `RepliedMessage`. The
link carries no more of the message's schema than that, so a message's
schema nests no message: a reply typed as the message it replies to would
nest without end, the generator would cut the nesting at a depth that
varies with the type a writer addresses the message by, and a write cut
shallower than the stored schema would drop the policies stored below
the cut and be refused.

resultSchema.description: What a room offers everyone its space admits: `ChatRoomOutput`.

$NAME.description: The room's name, for lists of pieces.

$UI.description: The room's own rendering, with its reviewed surfaces.

$VIEWS.description: The room's data face, as one group.
